title: Scout firm regulatory chronology and payment evidence
summary: Three CBOE settlements precede the 2015 Nasdaq AWC. The quote-fine payment is a firm-reported statement. Nasdaq's $3 million sanction and payment election remain distinct from receipt or completion evidence.
limitation: All four matters identify Scout as respondent. Bleich's representative signature does not impose a personal fine. The Nasdaq AWC is consented without admission or adjudication. Supplied evidence establishes no current balance or payment completion; chronology spacing is not elapsed time.

table.label: CBOE 12-0059
table.conditions: Two-sided quotes • censure + $10,000 firm fine. Settlement; firm reports paid 2013-02-04. Firm respondent; no personal fine.

table.label: CBOE 12-0099 / 12-0126
table.conditions: CCO / principal registration • censure + $7,500 firm fine. Settlement; no payment proof inferred. Firm respondent; no personal fine.

table.label: CBOE 14-0018
table.conditions: Rule 611 policies / surveillance • censure + $5,000 firm fine. Settlement; no payment proof inferred. Firm respondent; no personal fine.

table.label: Business cessation / BDW
table.conditions: BrokerCheck cessation; AWC reports BDW filing. Nasdaq membership termination separately 2014-08-18. Firm respondent; no personal fine.

table.label: Nasdaq execution / election
table.conditions: Bleich signs as Scout Managing Member. Quarterly payment election over four years; no receipts. Firm respondent; no personal fine.

table.label: Nasdaq AWC 20100243866-01
table.conditions: Regulation SHO / supervision • censure + $3,000,000 firm fine. Consent without admission or adjudication; completion unknown. Firm respondent; no personal fine.
